name: proposal-strategist-agent
description: AI agent that turns an RFP into win themes, an executive summary, and a proposal architecture (CLI + web app)

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.demo: node agent.js --rfp samples/sample-rfp.md --company samples/sample-company.md --buyer "Metro Logistics Authority" --out out/demo
scripts.dry-run: node agent.js --rfp samples/sample-rfp.md --company samples/sample-company.md --buyer "Metro Logistics Authority" --dry-run
